### Casa d'Arte Futurista Depero

Visit information

![Casa Depero](https://media.mart.tn.it/media/5ysfxran/4-casa-depero-mart-fernando-guerra.jpg?center=0.87304953732492685,0.34601653551961509&mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080&rnd=132723697736330000)
> "When my livelihood will depend on yesterday's ideas, I will be afraid of copycats"
>
> Fortunato Depero

On Tuesday, December 1st, setup work will take place at Casa Depero. Access for the public will, however, remain guaranteed.

Casa d'Arte Futurista Depero is the only museum founded by a Futurist – Depero himself, in 1957 – as an irreverent, visionary project: innovation, irony, and the breaking down of all hierarchies in the arts. Depero, a true pioneer of contemporary design, personally designed every detail: the mosaics, the furniture, the painted panels. The building is a ten-minute walk from the Mart, in the elegant historic centre of medieval Rovereto.

[Learn more](/en/mart/casa-d-arte-futurista-depero-118228)

### How to get to Casa Depero

#### Via dei Portici 38, 38068 Rovereto TN

- [By car](#auto)
- [By bike](#bicicletta)
- [By plane](#aereo)
- [By train](#treno)

Highway A22, exit Rovereto. Exit the highway and follow the signs for Casa Depero.

Coming from the north, along the [South Adige Valley bicycle route](https://www.visittrentino.info/en/guida/tour/pista-ciclabile-valle-dell-adige_tour_7024832) exit at km 54 at Borgo Sacco district and continue towards Rovereto Centro along the Pista del Leno no. 2 [(yellow signs)](http://www.comune.rovereto.tn.it/content/view/full/9115) until you reach the old town centre.

Continue toward Via dei Portici.

You can rent an electric bike through the e-bike sharing service.

More information at this [link](https://www.visitrovereto.it/en/info/moving-around/).

[ABD Airport Bolzano Dolomiti](https://www.bolzanoairport.it)

[Catullo Airport Verona Villafranca](https://www.aeroportoverona.it)

Get off at Rovereto train station. Walk along Corso Rosmini to Piazza Rosmini, turn right onto via Orefici towards Piazza del Nettuno, and continue along Via Mercerie. Continue along via dei Portici for about 100m. Alternatively, taxis are available outside the station.

For information on timetables and tickets visit the [Trenitalia](https://www.trenitalia.com/) or [DeutscheBahn](https://www.bahn.com/it/view/index.shtml) websites

### Deperian Itineraries

Discover Rovereto and surrounds following in the footsteps of Fortunato Depero: an original itinerary through the places that the artist experienced, chronicled and depicted.

[Learn more](/en/visit/deperian-itineraries-123599)

### Services

Below are some of the services available at Mart's central location. The complete list can be found in our [Service Charter (in Italian).](/amministrazionetrasparente/carta-dei-servizi-e-standard-di-qualita-137961 "Carta dei servizi e standard di qualità") There is also a section for your suggestions. For more information on accessibility [visit the section A Museum for all](/en/visit/a-museum-for-all-118210 "(2.6 Museo per tutti)").

#### Cloakroom service

Free service on the lower ground floor. Please leave any luggage, parcels, umbrellas and large bags in our cloakroom. You can bring bags smaller than 25x30 cm into the exhibition spaces.

#### Changing table

A changing table is available within the restrooms on the lower ground floor of Casa Depero.

#### Lift

A lift is available to access the exhibition floors.

#### Video guide to Casa d'Arte Futurista Depero

Dedicated to the exploration of Fortunato Depero's art, it offers two different itineraries: adults, and families with children aged 4 to 10. Available for a fee in Italian, English and German. Cost: €3. Info T. +39 0464 480273.  
\* Services are temporarily suspended until further notice.

#### Pet access

Guide dogs are welcome at all locations. No other pets are allowed.

![Bookshop](https://media.mart.tn.it/media/44xl0x4n/1-casa-depero-mart-carlo-baroni.jpg?center=0.57534058579172664,0.7714198922410348&mode=crop&width=640&height=360&rnd=132647955053000000)

### Bookshop

At the entrance to the Casa d'Arte you will find some original gift ideas inspired by the work of Fortunato Depero: bags, stationery, jigsaw puzzles, aprons, scarves, lamps, mugs and jewellery created in collaboration with selected manufacturers and students from Verona's Accademia di Belle Arti.
